products.name: Devin
products.description: Devin 是 Cognition 的旗舰产品，被描述为 AI 软件工程师，能够分析需求、制定计划、编写代码、运行测试、调试故障、调查问题并实施变更，目标是将 AI 编码从代码补全推向任务完成。
products.target_customers: 大型企业，包括芯片设计、航空、金融服务、汽车和 AI 基础设施等行业的组织
features: Devin Auto-Triage：对事故进行初步调查
Devin Security Swarm：识别和分类软件漏洞
Devin Automations：在 Slack、GitHub、Linear 等系统中事件触发时自动启动工作

evidence_refs.quote: Devin is designed to work on complete engineering tasks. It can: analyse requirements, create a plan, write code, run tests, debug failures, investigate issues, and implement changes.

The platform now includes capabilities such as: Devin Auto-Triage, which can perform an initial investigation of incidents. It also includes: Devin Security Swarm, designed to identify and triage software vulnerabilities.
